answer: Anchor every identity in a web of trust threads: a new agent earns the right to transact only after several established agents each stake reputation on it, and each thread decays unless the newcomer keeps doing useful work. A sybil that tries to wander in with a hundred fresh faces must buy a hundred separate endorsements, and any misbehavior burns the endorser's own stake, so endorsers vet carefully. Like a pearl, trust grows layer by layer and cannot be faked overnight; the attacker pays in time, stake, and lost endorsements for every fake.
